@defer.214: Learn Headbutt from the Ilex Forest tutor and try group A trees on Route 33. Trade Heracross into Platinum.
@defer.446: Wake Snorlax in Kanto after restoring the Power Plant and receiving the EXPN Card. Trade it to Platinum. Use Rock Climb in Veilstone to get Full Incense, give it to Snorlax and breed it with Ditto in Solaceon.
@defer.349: After Surf, fish the six Feebas tiles on Emerald Route 119 with any rod. Include Feebas in a Pal Park batch.
@defer.273: Use Headbutt on group A trees in Viridian Forest. Trade Seedot to Platinum.
@defer.287: Use Headbutt on the four trees in the northwest corner of Route 25. Trade Slakoth to Platinum.
@defer.234: On your final return to Platinum, use the Poké Radar in Route 207 grass. Stantler occupies 22% of this Radar table. Catch it directly in the main save.
@section.1.description: Choose your Sinnoh starter, catch the early route species and defeat Roark in Oreburgh.
@section.2.description: Free Valley Windworks, start checking Honey Trees and cross Eterna Forest to reach Gardenia.
@section.3.description: Use Cut to visit the Old Chateau, recover the bicycle and reach Fantina in Hearthome.
@section.4.description: Pick up the Good Rod on Route 209 and explore Solaceon on the way to Maylene in Veilstone.
@section.5.description: Follow Route 214 to Pastoria, check the Great Marsh and challenge Crasher Wake.
@section.6.description: Clear the northern route to Celestic, collect Surf and cross the water to Byron in Canalave.
@section.7.description: Investigate the lakes, collect Rock Climb on Route 217 and defeat Candice in Snowpoint.
@section.8.description: Take on Team Galactic at its headquarters and follow Giratina from Spear Pillar into the Distortion World.
@section.9.description: Win the Beacon Badge, climb the waterfall to Victory Road and defeat the League to prepare for the National Dex.
@section.emerald.description: Start the first donor campaign with Mudkip and trade in Treecko and Torchic from short saves. Migrate {targets} target species in {batches} Pal Park batches ({slots} Pokémon including fillers).
@section.frlg.description: A second FireRed can replace LeafGreen for the Charmander step. Choose the three different starters across three runs. On DS or DS Lite, migrate each directly through Pal Park in a separate batch of six. With GBA link trades, gather all three in the main FireRed and migrate one batch.
@section.diamond.description: Choose {Diamond} for a missing Sinnoh starter line, obtain Cranidos and Stunky, and trade them to Platinum.
@section.pearl.description: Choose {Pearl} for the other missing Sinnoh starter line, then collect Misdreavus, Shieldon and Glameow for trade to Platinum.
@section.hgss.description: Collect the Johto starters, version exclusives and legendaries across Johto and Kanto. Headbutt can supply Heracross, and Kanto’s Snorlax provides a breeding parent for Munchlax.
@section.evolutions.description: Evolve each source Pokémon as soon as its conditions are met, including during earlier story stages. Keep separate specimens for branching lines.
@section.platinum.finish.description: Unlock the National Dex and explore the Battle Zone. Return for legendary encounters and breeding as your donor Pokémon arrive.
@section.events.description: Collect compatible historical gifts and restore original in-game events on separate saves before trading the Pokémon into Platinum.
